name: Studded cross
function: The block above the masters with two horizontal outlets for the wing valves; it splits the vertical bore to the frac side and the flowback side.

tabs.overview: A forged block with the vertical bore and two side bores at 90 degrees, studded outlets on each side for the wing valves, and flanged top and bottom. A tee is used when only one wing is needed. Some stacks add a third outlet for instrumentation.
tabs.engineering: API 6A pressure-containing block rated with the stack; studded outlets take the wing valve flanges with BX gaskets.
tabs.safety: The cross sees the highest erosion on the stack at the frac wing side; inspect the bore and outlet after each well.
tabs.evidence: API 6A (S1) for pressure-containing parts and connections; public OEM pages (S2, S3, S5, S11, S12) for configurations; field and manufacturing practice (S9).

hazards.control: Pressure test before pumping; bleed down and verify zero before breaking any connection.
Tree saver in the wellhead; valves fully open or fully closed only; iron inspection.
